_comment: Object lifecycle for the Storage bucket. Applied with:
The prefix matches what the backend actually wrote: ID documents went to
kyc-documents/{uid}/{type}/... The users/{uid}/kyc/ path in storage.rules
was defence-in-depth for direct client access and was never used, so do
not 'correct' this prefix to match it - that would stop the rule matching
KYC capture has since been removed from the product. This rule is what is
still ageing out the documents that were captured before that, 15 days
after upload. Firestore fields (id_document, kyc_status) are NOT covered
and still need a one-off purge.
